subject: Steel Armor
text: Steel Armor can be purchased in Melmond for 45,000 GP.

evidence.quote: Now, it's time to head to Melmond...buy Steel Armor for your Fighter...Fighter: 45,000(Steel Armor)

subject: Silver Bracelet
text: A Silver Bracelet costs 4000 GP in Melmond.

evidence.quote:
You will need to buy a Silver Bracelet for each of your 
Black Belts, Thieves, White Mages, and Black Mages...Thief: 4000(Silver Bracelet)

subject: WARP
text: The WARP spell takes the party back to the starting point of the floor they were just on.

evidence.quote:
WARP takes your party back 
to the starting point of the floor they were just on.

subject: LIFE
text: The LIFE spell revives a fallen party member with one HP outside of battle, but does not work in battle.

evidence.quote:
LIFE revives a dead party member (duh!).  However, 
this party member will only have one HP left when they get revived, so be 
careful, or you'll find yourself soon casting it again.  Also, this does not 
work in battle.

subject: Revival
text: There are only 3 ways to revive a character in the game: go to a clinic, cast LIFE, or cast LIF2.

evidence.quote:
There are only 3 ways to revive someone in this game: Go to a 
clinic (located in every town), cast LIFE, or cast LIF2.

subject: SLO2
text: SLO2 works against almost any non-undead monster in the game and can incapacitate bosses including Lich and Kary.

evidence.quote:
SLO2, on the other hand, works against almost 
any non-undead monster in the game, including some bosses.  I once got it to 
work on LICH and KARY, to fiends that get really wasted when they can't attack.

subject: Titan
text: The Titan will not let the party pass unless given a RUBY.

evidence.quote: the Titan won't let you pass unless you give him a RUBY.

subject: Earth Cave
text: Before entering the Earth Cave, carry 99 HEAL potions, at least 40 PURE potions, and about 5 Softs.

evidence.quote:
Make sure you 
have 99 HEAL potions and at least 40 PURE potions before you enter.  There will 
be an enemy that can turn you to stone, so pick up about 5 Softs.

subject: HALL OF GIANTS
text: Every square in the Hall of Giants is spiked with encounters of Giants and Iguanas.

evidence.quote:
If you go to your left, you will find 
the HALL OF GIANTS.  Every square here is spiked with a varying number of Giants 
and Iguanas.

subject: Earth Cave
text: A chest in the treasure room north of the entrance of Earth Cave contains GP.

evidence.quote:
If you go up from the entrance, you will find a treasure room with some 
GP in a chest.

subject: Earth
text: An Earth enemy guards a spiked square in the treasure room and can easily deal 90 damage to a Fighter equipped with Steel Armor.

evidence.quote:
Watch out, one of the squares is spiked with an Earth, a 
powerful enemy...He can easily 
do 90 damage to a Fighter fully loaded with Steel Armor

subject: Cockatrice
text: Cockatrices inflict Stone status using Squint, appear in packs of at least 4, and die quickly to ICE2.

evidence.quote:
Along the way down, watch for Cockatrice.  They can use 
squint, which will cause Stone status...If 
you encounter a Cockatrice (the usually come in packs of at least 4), use ICE2, 
and they should all die quickly.

subject: Coral Sword
text: A Coral Sword is found along the way down in the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote:
There's no real valuable treasure 
along the way, except a Coral Sword.

subject: Vampire
text: The Vampire in the Earth Cave has about 150 HP and can be defeated using HRM2 or FIR2 or 3.

evidence.quote:
[semi]BOSS FIGHT- Vampire
HP-About 150...White Mages should use HRM2...Have a 
Black Mage use FIR2 or 3.

subject: RUBY
text: After defeating the Vampire, take the RUBY from the chest in his room.

evidence.quote:
When he does, take his RUBY from the chest and exit the same way 
you came.

subject: Sarda the Sage
text: Sarda the Sage in Sarda's Cave gives the party the STAFF required to break the stone plate in the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote:
Make your way out 
the other side and to Sarda's Cave.  When you get there, you'll notice you're 
welcomed, and the Sage gives you the STAFF you need to break the plate in the 
Earth Cave.
